ben-release: Quick heads-up — planning to bump package and release v2.5.0 today. Freeze at 18:00 PT, please avoid landing anything that touches runtime or ci scripts after 17:30. We'll do a green-sweep from 17:35.

alice-eng: Ack. tagging final PRs now. I have one small changelog tweak coming.

chris-ci: I'll kick a full matrix run at 17:35 and post the job links. If anything flakes, ping me directly and mark with :flake: label.

maya-sre: FYI, I'll reserve one extra runner for the spike. If we see queueing I'll bump parallelism to 8.

tom-qa: I'll run the regression subset and smoke the web e2e at 17:50. If anything fails that's flaky, I'll open a triage thread.

rachel-pm: Changelog PM note: include migration note for config key rename. Can someone add a short blurb? I'll approve after.

luis-dev: Added blurb in changelog draft and pushed to release/changelog-2.5 branch. Command I ran:
```
git checkout -b release/changelog-2.5
# edit CHANGELOG.md
git commit -am "chore(changelog): add config rename note"
git push origin release/changelog-2.5
```

ci-bot: Full matrix started: https://ci.redwood.dev/teams/infra/builds/98765 (running).

chris-ci: Build 98765 shows a flake on `tests/pipeline/test_retry.py::test_retry_backoff` — retrying a couple times now.

tom-qa: Noted. If it's transient we can quarantine and proceed; we'll collect logs and mark it as flaky with PR link.

ben-release: Thanks all. Plan: if CI green by 18:10 and no new blockers, we merge the bump, trigger cut, and cut release tag at 18:15 PT. Anyone who can't make this, ping now.

alice-eng: I'm good.

maya-sre: Good here.

luis-dev: Will watch the PRs.

rachel-pm: Good to go from PM side.

chris-ci: Build stabilized after two retries, all green now. I'll post final artefacts shortly.

ci-bot: Build 98765 passed. Artefacts: https://ci.redwood.dev/artifacts/98765
